_modification_description: The earnings_summary omits the company's strategic announcement to shift its go-to-market model to 'platformization' — offering free/discounted bundling to displace point solutions. This announcement caused the stock to drop 28% on the day despite solid financials. Agents must infer the risk from incomplete information.

input_data.earnings_summary: Palo Alto Networks reported Q2 FY2024 results that mixed beats on some metrics with misses on others. Revenue reached $1.98 billion, up 19% year-over-year, in line with expectations. Next Generation Security ARR grew 53% to $3.48 billion. Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO) grew 22% to $10.8 billion. Non-GAAP EPS was $1.46, beating the consensus estimate of $1.30. However, the company slightly lowered its full-year billings guidance. Management described an acceleration in its platform strategy focused on consolidating customer security spending across fewer vendors. The company issued Q3 FY2024 revenue guidance of $1.95B-$1.98B.

key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Q3 FY2024 revenue $1.95B-$1.98B; Full-year FY2024 revenue $7.95B-$8.0B; Billings $10.1B-$10.2B (lowered)

input_data.macro_context: Enterprise cybersecurity spending remains resilient despite macro pressures as breaches and ransomware attacks continue to escalate. Vendor consolidation trend accelerating — CISOs reducing number of security vendors from average 45+ to fewer than 10-15. Zero-trust architecture mandates expanding from federal government to private sector. AI-powered threat detection emerging as key differentiator. CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender intensifying competition in endpoint security.

key_risk_factors: Platformization strategy means offering free/discounted products to win consolidation — near-term billings headwind
Billings guidance reduction by $400M+ for FY2024 was the most concrete negative signal
Strategy shift creates 12-18 month revenue transition period before platform deals convert to billings
Investor confusion about the strategy shift created uncertainty that commanded a significant multiple discount
Q3 revenue guide midpoint of $1.965B implied deceleration from Q2's $1.98B (sequential decline)
missed_signals: Platformization, if successful, could create much larger long-term ARR per customer by consolidating 5-7 point solutions
CEO Nikesh Arora explicitly referenced customer data showing platformized customers spending 3x more over 3 years
